title: Project Grade: Enhancement + Metadata
prompt: GRADED PROJECT CHECKPOINT — finish your Documentation Hub: (1) a 'copy install command' affordance as progressive enhancement — a <details> disclosure containing the command in a <code> block (readable without JS) plus a button inside it with popovertarget-less text 'Copy' marked aria-label="Copy install command"; (2) hreflang alternates for en and vi pointing at https://docs.example.com/en/ and /vi/ paths; (3) a <meta name="robots"> that allows indexing.

tests.name: install command readable without JS
tests.hint: A disclosure with the command in <code> works for everyone, script or no script.

tests.name: copy affordance is named
tests.hint: A short 'Copy' button benefits from a fuller name — this is the one aria-label that adds information.

tests.name: bilingual alternates declared
tests.hint: Each alternate names its locale AND its path — both must be right.

tests.name: indexable
tests.hint: Either omit robots entirely or write index, follow — public documentation wants to be found.
